PC: Remove the cap and shake the inhaler vigorously.
If you have not used the inhaler in a while, you may need to prime it.
Hold the inhaler 1 to 2 inches (2.5 to 5 centimeters) in front of your mouth.
Start breathing in slowly through your mouth, then press down once on the inhaler.
Continue breathing in slowly and deeply.
If you can, hold your breath as you slowly count to 10, attaining deep penetration into your lungs.
If you are using inhaled, quick-relief medicine (beta-agonists), delay taking your next puff by 1 minute. No wait time is necessary for other medicines.
After using your inhaler, flush out your mouth with water to reduce side effects from your medicine.
ICS: The provider should incorporate teach back, effective questioning and avoiding jargon in the explanation.
